summary: Userpurge memory wrapper that backs up from the receiver by 8 bytes to reach an offset header, runs ConstructorWithVTableFixup on that header with the second register argument and three stack locals, then conditionally frees the same pointer via FreeWrapper when the low bit of the flag argument is set, and returns the header pointer.

local_names.a2: second userpurge register argument passed through to ConstructorWithVTableFixup
local_names.a3: flag byte whose low bit selects the free path
local_names.v3: offset header pointer (a1 - 8) kept across the constructor call
local_names.v6: uninitialized stack local forwarded as constructor argument
local_names.v7: uninitialized stack local forwarded as constructor argument
local_names.v8: uninitialized stack local forwarded as constructor argument

operations.description: Compute the offset header pointer v3 as the receiver a1 minus 8

Free path taken only when the low bit of flag a3 is set (a3 & 1 != 0)

Return the offset header pointer v3
